values.note: January 2026: water and electric $35 a night, $200 a week, $750 a month; full hookup $40 a night, $240 a week, $900 a month (one-week minimum); tents $25 a night. Pay in advance (envelopes at the information booth); unpaid stays are charged double.

fees.source: City page ('RV Sites with electric, water and sewer hookup: $40/Night, $240/week, $900/Month (**MINIMUM 1 WEEK STAY)'; 'RV Sites electric and water hookup: $35/Night, $200/week, $750/Month'; 'Tent Sites $25 per Tent per Night'; 'Failure to pay in advance will result in a penalty of twice the amount of the camping fee.'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Reserve by calling City Hall (weekdays 8-4), paid by credit card over the phone; a cancellation forfeits one night. 10 sites are reservation-only and 14 first come, first served. Full-hookup sites carry a one-week minimum stay; water-and-electric sites have none.

booking.source: City page ('You can call City hall at 218-634-1850 during business hours M-F 8am-4pm to reserve an RV site. The cancellation policy for reserved sites is 1 night stay.'; '(**MINIMUM 1 WEEK STAY)' on the full-hookup line) + 2026 brochure ('10 Sites are reservation only. 14 sites are first come first serve. Reservations must be paid with a credit card over the phone to secure a campsite.'), read 2026-11-11

hookups.source: City page ('RV Sites with electric, water and sewer hookup'; 'RV Sites electric and water hookup'), read 2026-11-11; amperage not stated, so the stored 50 is left as it is

sites.source: 2026 brochure ('20 RV Camping Sites'); city site map numbers sites 1-20; city page says '20+ RV sites, unlimited primitive camping', read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: City page ('restrooms with showers') + 2026 brochure ('Dump Station', 'Bathroom/Shower Facility'; 'RV Dump Fee $10 ... These fees do not apply to Campers that are staying in the campground.'), read 2026-11-11

season.source: 2026 brochure ('Open May to October Weather Permitting'), read 2026-11-11

note: City of Baudette's campground in Timber Mill Park on the east side of town, in pines south of the Rainy River, with a public boat landing, fish-cleaning house and ball fields alongside. Unlimited primitive tent camping. --Claude
summary: City page (Jan 2026 rates) + 2026 brochure + site map read: $35 W/E / $40 full hookup confirmed (full hookup one-week minimum); 20 sites, sewer at the full-hookup sites, dump; reserve by phone for 10 sites, 14 FCFS; season May-October. Amps and pull-through not stated (stored values left). Not waterfront confirmed.
flags: Not waterfront confirmed: the site loop (sites 1-20 on the city map, ~48.7130-48.7142, -94.5786 to -94.5776) sits ~150-200 m south of the Rainy River behind a continuous forest belt on Esri imagery; site 1 by the fish-cleaning house is the nearest.

Full-hookup sites have a one-week minimum ('(**MINIMUM 1 WEEK STAY)'), so for a one-night stay the usable sites are the $35 water-and-electric ones; nightly_high $40 is the weekly-minimum full-hookup rate. Not written as min_stay because it binds only those sites.
Brochure weekly full-hookup rate ($200) differs from the January 2026 web page ($240); the web page is used.
Pin 48.71380,-94.57830 is inside the site loop; no move. Phone 218-634-1850 (City Hall) confirmed.
Note cleaned: dropped the site count, hookups, pull-through, showers and 'Reserve via City Hall' (fields hold them).
